purpose: This module builds a boolean per-frame dead-time mask that marks which frames represent non-playing periods in a badminton video. It supports three production policies: REPLAY (based on court/track/homography signals), COMPOSITION (based on editor cuts and keep votes), and UNION (combination of both).

public_api.name: build_dead_mask
public_api.role: Main entry point that constructs a boolean dead-time mask by dispatching to REPLAY, COMPOSITION, or UNION strategies based on the mode parameter. Callers use this to generate frame-by-frame annotations of dead time.
